note: Decision support, not a decision. A weighted score is computed only when every baseline criterion has a recorded independent or community score. Hard vetoes are evaluated separately and cannot be offset by high scores. Extended considerations are recorded qualitatively and are never weighted.

criteria.title: Need severity
criteria.evidenceRequirement: Population-specific need from a source whose population and geography match the candidate.

criteria.title: Existing impact evidence
criteria.evidenceRequirement: Independent review of relevant studies and their transferability.

criteria.title: Feasibility and cost
criteria.evidenceRequirement: Lawful data access, accountable delivery partner and costed plan.

criteria.title: Additionality
criteria.evidenceRequirement: Evidence that research or service adds value beyond what already exists.

criteria.title: Measurable learning
criteria.evidenceRequirement: A measurable, prespecified primary outcome with a credible comparison.

extendedConsiderations.title: Recurrence of the underlying mechanism
extendedConsiderations.evidenceRequirement: Documented presence of the mechanism in other contexts, not assumed.

extendedConsiderations.title: Reusability of methods
extendedConsiderations.evidenceRequirement: Whether the evaluation package can be adapted without rebuilding.

extendedConsiderations.title: Potential adoption by other institutions
extendedConsiderations.evidenceRequirement: Verified interest from accountable institutions; never assumed.

extendedConsiderations.title: Scalability constraints
extendedConsiderations.evidenceRequirement: Known constraints on delivery capacity, cost and legal transfer.

extendedConsiderations.title: Expected benefit per unit of resource
extendedConsiderations.evidenceRequirement: Costed estimates with uncertainty; undefined when effects are zero or uncertain.

extendedConsiderations.title: Distributional consequences
extendedConsiderations.evidenceRequirement: Who gains, who may be excluded, and spillovers on nonparticipants.

extendedConsiderations.title: Neglected populations
extendedConsiderations.evidenceRequirement: Evidence that a population is underserved. Small, highly deprived populations must not be dismissed for being less scalable.

extendedConsiderations.title: Long-term sustainability
extendedConsiderations.evidenceRequirement: Funding and institutional continuity beyond any study.

extendedConsiderations.title: Evidence uncertainty
extendedConsiderations.evidenceRequirement: Explicit statement of what is unknown and how it could change the decision.
